dedupe_keys.name: 中津川市 gtfs transit data

description:
中津川市: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by 中津川市. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Nakatsugawa, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. Coverage: Nakatsugawa, Gifu Prefecture, Japan. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Nakatsugawa, Gifu Prefecture, Japan). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Translations. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. Note in the listing: 収録路線：
　阿木（希望する降車場所に直行する「みちくさ線」を除く）
　落合（一部の区域運行を除く）
　坂下
　加子母
　福岡地区については、運行形態変更のため2022/10改正からデータに含んでおりません
　付知地区については、希望場所に直行する運行のため、データに含んでおりません。

　GTFS-JP　３版対応 It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata.
